summary: Public health graduate with a background spanning clinical rotations, overseas worker logistics management in Ethiopia, and customer-facing operations in the UAE. The common thread across these roles has been working in environments where communication gaps create real operational risk, and finding practical ways to close them. Fluent across five languages, which has been more a practical necessity than a formal qualification in the roles held.
summary2: Currently seeking to bring that mix of health knowledge, data handling, and people experience into a team where operational quality and cross-functional delivery genuinely matter.
